template_data.lead_html: Two documents. One negotiation. Most small businesses only read one.

rows.what_html: Teaming agreement — gets you in the door, not in the money
Workshare clause — opens at 25%, push for 35–40%
Subcontract agreement — scope, billing, and IP locked in here

template_data.closer: KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING BEFORE YOU SIGN IT.
